sourcePolicies.assignment: actual source seed parity; even=P1, odd=P2

sourceReplay.relayLimit: fail/reject according to module contract; never reinterpret as scientific outcome
sourceReplay.trajectoryIdentity: SHA-256 of ordered canonical move-key sequence plus terminal/source metadata

SFCDF-TRANSFER.candidateEligibility: assigned-family Namua and Mtaji anchors both exist, are nonterminal, phase-correct, source replay has no relay-limit
SFCDF-TRANSFER.selection: within cell ascending SHA-256 rank; skip duplicate full trajectory identity and any already-selected RAW root identity
SFCDF-TRANSFER.measurement: LGTGMIV depth-5 -> SFCDF C1/C6 production and independent exact
SFCDF-TRANSFER.developmentOutput: support counts, definedness counts, identity manifest, measurement core hash only; no paired effect direction summary or p-value
SFCDF-TRANSFER.stagePass: all 4 cells reach 10 pairs and all selected C1/C6 values are defined with production/independent canonical equality

SILGM-TRANSFER.phaseAssignment: independent SHA-256 salt parity / namua or mtaji
SILGM-TRANSFER.rootFamilyAssignment: independent SHA-256 salt parity / RF1 or RF2
SILGM-TRANSFER.anchor: phase-specific anchor from assigned root family
SILGM-TRANSFER.widthClass: HIGH if rootLegalWidth>threshold; LOW if <; EQUAL rejected
SILGM-TRANSFER.cells: 2 policies x 2 root families x 2 phases x 2 width classes
SILGM-TRANSFER.selection: within cell ascending SHA-256 rank; one root per trajectory; skip duplicate full trajectory and RAW root identity
SILGM-TRANSFER.developmentOutput: cell support, exactness/estimability counts, identity manifest and measurement core hash only; no HIGH-vs-LOW risk difference, direction or p-value
SILGM-TRANSFER.stagePass: all 16 cells reach 8 roots; all three contrasts estimable for every selected root; production/independent E3 exact

GCLD-TRANSFER.candidateEligibilityBeforeGeometry: nonterminal through ply72, no source relay-limit
GCLD-TRANSFER.candidateSelection: per policy ascending SHA-256 candidate rank; skip duplicate full trajectory identity; candidate manifest frozen before any depth-5 preflight
GCLD-TRANSFER.preflight: all 15 roots independently pass unchanged CRCLGR depth-5 deterministic reconstructibility limits in production and independent implementations with exact eligibility/reason agreement
GCLD-TRANSFER.measuredSelection: first 16 eligible trajectories in each already-frozen candidate order; no replacement after coordinate generation begins
GCLD-TRANSFER.developmentOutput: candidate/preflight/measured support, definedness/exactness counts, identity manifest and measurement core hash only; no actual-control sign summary or p-value
GCLD-TRANSFER.stagePass: 24 candidates per policy available; at least 16 per policy preflight eligible; 16 measured per policy exact across production/independent; all four endpoints defined

nonEstimableRule: deterministic support/resource/definedness target not met without integrity mismatch; no seed extension or replacement beyond frozen selection
technicalInvalidRule: identity, source replay, production/independent, serializer, exact arithmetic, execution-count, authorization, or mandatory provenance mismatch
